summary: Bar of controlled filters with saved views managed by the consumer.
whenToUse: Placing filters and views above a table or list.
whenNotToUse: Complex filters with many dependencies: use a dedicated form or DataTable.

props.name: views
props.description: Saved views provided by the consumer.

props.name: onSaveView
props.description: Required to show the save command; persistence is up to the consumer.

props.name: onDeleteView
props.description: Shows the delete command for the active view.

props.name: onClear
props.description: Optional action to clear the filters.

keyboard.action: Uses native select controls to choose filters and views.

accessibility: Each select has an associated label.
Native controls keep their keyboard navigation.
responsive: Filters wrap and take the available width on narrow screens.
customization: Customize colors via --dc-color-* tokens and sizes with external CSS.
commonMistakes: Don't expect automatic persistence: save views and apply their values in the consumer.
limits: Views and persistence are fully controlled by the consumer.
